summary: An orphan girl grows up in hardship and becomes a governess who falls in love with her mysterious employer Mr Rochester.
A witty young woman and a proud rich gentleman slowly overcome their first bad impressions and fall in love.
A Transylvanian count travels to England to drink blood and spread his curse while a group of friends hunts the vampire.
A young scientist builds a living creature from dead body parts and is haunted by the monster he created.
A poor orphan boy escapes a workhouse and falls in with a gang of child pickpockets in London.
A mysterious millionaire throws huge parties on Long Island hoping to win back the woman he loves.
In a totalitarian state Big Brother watches everyone and a man secretly rebels against the party.
Farm animals overthrow their human owner but the pigs slowly become as cruel as the humans.
A home-loving hobbit joins a group of dwarves and a wizard on a quest to win treasure from a dragon.
A sea captain obsessively hunts the giant white whale that took his leg.
A boy finds a treasure map and sails with pirates including the one-legged Long John Silver.
An inventor travels far into the future and meets the gentle Eloi and the underground Morlocks.
Martians invade England with giant tripod machines and heat rays.
An old Cuban fisherman fights for days to catch a giant marlin far out at sea.
A small prince from a tiny asteroid visits planets and learns about love and friendship from a fox.
A gentleman bets he can travel around the whole world in eighty days with his loyal servant.
Captain Nemo explores the oceans in his submarine the Nautilus.
A girl falls down a rabbit hole into a strange world with a grinning cat and a mad tea party.
